# Function to create a horizontal eye legend
f.fig2_legend_eyes_horizontal <- function(plot_width, plot_height, text_size, circle_parameters) {
  # Helper function for null values
  "%||%" <- function(x, y) {
    if (is.null(x)) y else x
  }
  
  # Calculate spacing for horizontal layout
  # We'll divide the plot width into sections
  section_width <- plot_width / 6  # 6 elements (3 icons + 3 text blocks)
  
  # Horizontal positions for elements
  x1 <- section_width * 0.5        # Position for Bud eye
  x2 <- section_width * 1.5        # Position for Bud text
  x3 <- section_width * 2.5        # Position for Aletta eye
  x4 <- section_width * 3.5        # Position for Aletta text
  x5 <- section_width * 4.5        # Position for Station circle
  x6 <- section_width * 5.5        # Position for Station text
  
  # Vertical position - center everything vertically
  y_center <- plot_height / 2
  
  # Circle size calculation (adjust as needed)
  circle_size <- section_width * 0.4
  
  # Create data objects
  # Bud eye
  new_eye.b <- data.frame(x=x1, y=y_center, image=b$image[1])
  
  # Aletta eye
  new_eye.a <- data.frame(x=x3, y=y_center) %>% 
    st_as_sf(., coords=c("x", "y"))
  st_crs(new_eye.a) <- st_crs(a)
  
  # Station circle with proper creation
  center_point <- st_point(c(x5, y_center))
  center_sf <- st_sf(geometry = st_sfc(center_point))
  st_crs(center_sf) <- st_crs(a)
  new_circle <- st_buffer(center_sf, dist=circle_size)
  
  # Extract styling from circle_parameters
  circle_color1 <- circle_parameters["circle_color1"]
  circle_color2 <- circle_parameters["circle_color2"]
  base <- as.numeric(circle_parameters["base"])
  outline <- as.numeric(circle_parameters["outline"])
  line1 <- circle_parameters["line1"]
  line2 <- circle_parameters["line2"]
  
  # Adjust line thickness for legend
  legend_base <- base * 0.8    # Still visible but not too thick
  legend_outline <- outline * 0.8
  
  # Text labels
  text1 <- "TC Bud Eye"
  text2 <- "TC Aletta Eye"
  text3 <- "200km Diameter\nStation 3.5"
  
  # Create horizontal legend
  p <- ggplot() +
    # Apply white outline circle
    geom_sf(data = new_circle, color = circle_color1, linetype = line1, 
            linewidth = legend_outline, alpha = 0, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    # Apply orange dashed circle
    geom_sf(data = new_circle, color = circle_color2, linetype = line2, 
            linewidth = legend_base, alpha = 0, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    
    # Add Aletta eye
    geom_sf(data=new_eye.a, shape=aletta_symbol, col=aletta_color, 
            fill=aletta_color, size=aletta_size) +
    
    # Add Bud eye
    geom_image(data=new_eye.b, aes(x=x, y=y, image=image), size=0.15) + 
    scale_size_identity() +
    
    # Add text labels with horizontal alignment
    annotate("text", x=x2, y=y_center, label=text1, hjust=0, size=text_size/3) +
    annotate("text", x=x4, y=y_center, label=text2, hjust=0, size=text_size/3) +
    annotate("text", x=x6, y=y_center, label=text3, hjust=0, size=text_size/3) +
    
    # Clean theme
    theme_void() +
    
    # Set plot dimensions with fixed aspect ratio
    coord_sf(xlim=c(0, plot_width), ylim=c(0, plot_height), expand=FALSE, datum=NA)
  
  return(p)
}

# Test function to quickly create and save the horizontal eye legend
test_horizontal_eye_legend <- function() {
  # Set working directory
  setwd(wd)
  setwd(fig)
  
  # Create the horizontal eye legend
  legend_horizontal <- f.fig2_legend_eyes_horizontal(
    plot_width = 800,
    plot_height = 150,  # Made shorter since it's a horizontal layout
    text_size = 12,     # Adjusted for better readability
    circle_parameters = circle_parameters
  )
  
  # Save it to PDF for inspection
  pdf("test_horizontal_eye_legend.pdf", width=8, height=2)
  print(legend_horizontal)
  dev.off()
  
  # Return the legend object
  return(legend_horizontal)
}

# Modified version of the duplicate structure approach to include both legends
f.create_duplicate_structure_with_two_legends <- function(
  plot_obj,
  color_legend_obj,
  eye_legend_obj,
  rel_widths = c(14, 1),
  eye_legend_xmin = NULL,  # Will be calculated if NULL
  eye_legend_xmax = 1,
  eye_legend_ymin = -0.1,  # Previously tested position
  eye_legend_ymax = 0.15,  # Previously tested position
  preserve_axis_text = TRUE,
  create_diagnostic = FALSE
) {
  # Helper function for null values
  "%||%" <- function(x, y) {
    if (is.null(x)) y else x
  }
  
  # Calculate legend_xmin if not provided
  eye_legend_xmin <- eye_legend_xmin %||% (1 - (rel_widths[2] / sum(rel_widths)))
  
  # Create the original plot with color legend
  main_plot <- plot_grid(plot_obj, color_legend_obj, ncol=2, rel_widths=rel_widths, align="h")
  
  # If diagnostic mode, create a grid overlay
  if (create_diagnostic) {
    # Create a grid overlay to visualize coordinate space
    grid_plot <- ggplot() +
      # Add vertical lines at 0.1 intervals
      geom_vline(xintercept = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1), color = "blue", alpha = 0.5) +
      # Add horizontal lines at 0.1 intervals
      geom_hline(yintercept = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1), color = "red", alpha = 0.5) +
      # Add text labels for coordinates
      annotate("text", x = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1), y = 0.02, 
               label = paste0(seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)), 
               color = "blue", angle = 90, hjust = 0) +
      annotate("text", x = 0.02, y = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1), 
               label = paste0(seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)), 
               color = "red", hjust = 0) +
      # Highlight the legend position rectangle
      annotate("rect", 
               xmin = eye_legend_xmin, xmax = eye_legend_xmax,
               ymin = eye_legend_ymin, ymax = eye_legend_ymax,
               alpha = 0.2, fill = "green") +
      # Add a note about the highlighted area
      annotate("text", x = (eye_legend_xmin + eye_legend_xmax)/2, 
               y = (eye_legend_ymin + eye_legend_ymax)/2,
               label = "Eye Legend\nPosition", color = "darkgreen") +
      # Clean theme with labels
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(title = "Coordinate Grid Overlay",
           subtitle = paste0("Eye legend position: xmin=", eye_legend_xmin, 
                            ", xmax=", eye_legend_xmax,
                            ", ymin=", eye_legend_ymin,
                            ", ymax=", eye_legend_ymax))
    
    # Create grid diagnostic overlay
    diagnostic_overlay <- main_plot + 
      annotation_custom(
        grob = ggplotGrob(grid_plot),
        xmin = 0, xmax = 1, ymin = 0, ymax = 1
      )
    
    return(diagnostic_overlay)
  }
  
  # Create a transparent version of the main plot for overlay
  # (this preserves the original plot structure but makes it invisible)
  invisible_plot <- main_plot +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      # Conditionally preserve axis text
      axis.text = if (preserve_axis_text) element_text() else element_text(color = NA),
      axis.title = element_text(color = NA),
      axis.ticks = if (preserve_axis_text) element_line() else element_line(color = NA),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
  
  # Add the eye legend at the specified position
  final_plot <- invisible_plot + 
    annotation_custom(
      grob = ggplotGrob(eye_legend_obj),
      xmin = eye_legend_xmin,
      xmax = eye_legend_xmax,
      ymin = eye_legend_ymin,
      ymax = eye_legend_ymax
    )
  
  return(final_plot)
}

# Function to use the new approach to save PDFs with both legends
f.save_two_legend_pdfs <- function(
  plot_obj,
  color_legend_obj,
  eye_legend_obj,
  plot_type = "two",
  main_pdf_name = NULL,
  overlay_pdf_name = NULL,
  combined_pdf_name = NULL,
  main_width = 8.5,
  main_height = 11,
  rel_widths = c(14, 1),
  eye_legend_xmin = NULL,  # Will be calculated if NULL
  eye_legend_xmax = 1,
  eye_legend_ymin = -0.1,  # Previously tested position
  eye_legend_ymax = 0.15,  # Previously tested position
  preserve_axis_text = TRUE,
  create_diagnostic = FALSE
) {
  # Helper function for null values
  "%||%" <- function(x, y) {
    if (is.null(x)) y else x
  }
  
  # Set default filenames based on plot_type
  main_pdf_name <- main_pdf_name %||% paste0("figure_", plot_type, "_main.pdf")
  overlay_pdf_name <- overlay_pdf_name %||% paste0("figure_", plot_type, "_overlay.pdf")
  combined_pdf_name <- combined_pdf_name %||% paste0("figure_", plot_type, "_combined.pdf")
  
  # If diagnostic mode, modify overlay filename
  if (create_diagnostic) {
    overlay_pdf_name <- sub("\\.pdf$", "_diagnostic.pdf", overlay_pdf_name)
  }
  
  # 1. Save main figure with color legend
  pdf(main_pdf_name, height = main_height, width = main_width)
  main_plot <- plot_grid(plot_obj, color_legend_obj, ncol = 2, rel_widths = rel_widths, align = "h")
  print(main_plot)
  dev.off()
  
  # 2. Create and save overlay with eye legend
  overlay_plot <- f.create_duplicate_structure_with_two_legends(
    plot_obj = plot_obj,
    color_legend_obj = color_legend_obj,
    eye_legend_obj = eye_legend_obj,
    rel_widths = rel_widths,
    eye_legend_xmin = eye_legend_xmin,
    eye_legend_xmax = eye_legend_xmax,
    eye_legend_ymin = eye_legend_ymin,
    eye_legend_ymax = eye_legend_ymax,
    preserve_axis_text = preserve_axis_text,
    create_diagnostic = create_diagnostic
  )
  
  pdf(overlay_pdf_name, height = main_height, width = main_width)
  par(bg = "transparent")  # Set transparent background
  print(overlay_plot)
  dev.off()
  
  message(paste0(plot_type, " PDFs created successfully."))
  
  # Return file paths
  result <- list(
    main = main_pdf_name,
    overlay = overlay_pdf_name,
    combined = combined_pdf_name
  )
  
  # Add the diagnostic file path if created
  if (create_diagnostic) {
    result$diagnostic <- overlay_pdf_name
  }
  
  return(result)
}

# Modified main function to run the two-legend approach
f.run_two_legend_test <- function(
  # Required parameters
  plot_obj,
  color_legend_obj,
  eye_legend_obj,
  
  # Identification parameters
  plot_type = "two",
  
  # File parameters
  main_pdf_name = NULL,
  overlay_pdf_name = NULL,
  combined_pdf_name = NULL,
  optimized_pdf_name = NULL,
  
  # Dimension parameters
  main_width = 8.5,
  main_height = 11,
  rel_widths = c(14, 1),
  
  # Legend positioning parameters
  eye_legend_xmin = NULL,
  eye_legend_xmax = 1,
  eye_legend_ymin = -0.1,
  eye_legend_ymax = 0.15,
  
  # Display parameters
  preserve_axis_text = TRUE,
  
  # PDF combination parameters
  pdftk_options = NULL,
  gs_options = NULL,
  
  # Optimization parameters
  optimize_pdf = TRUE,
  quality = "prepress",
  compatibility = "1.5",
  embed_fonts = TRUE,
  compress_images = TRUE,
  
  # Diagnostic parameters
  create_diagnostic = FALSE,
  
  # Cleanup parameters
  delete_intermediate = FALSE
) {
  # Helper function for null values
  "%||%" <- function(x, y) {
    if (is.null(x)) y else x
  }
  
  # Set default filenames based on plot_type
  combined_pdf_name <- combined_pdf_name %||% paste0("figure_", plot_type, "_combined.pdf")
  optimized_pdf_name <- optimized_pdf_name %||% paste0("figure_", plot_type, "_optimized.pdf")
  
  # Create PDFs with both legends
  files <- f.save_two_legend_pdfs(
    plot_obj = plot_obj,
    color_legend_obj = color_legend_obj,
    eye_legend_obj = eye_legend_obj,
    plot_type = plot_type,
    main_pdf_name = main_pdf_name,
    overlay_pdf_name = overlay_pdf_name,
    combined_pdf_name = combined_pdf_name,
    main_width = main_width,
    main_height = main_height,
    rel_widths = rel_widths,
    eye_legend_xmin = eye_legend_xmin,
    eye_legend_xmax = eye_legend_xmax,
    eye_legend_ymin = eye_legend_ymin,
    eye_legend_ymax = eye_legend_ymax,
    preserve_axis_text = preserve_axis_text,
    create_diagnostic = create_diagnostic
  )
  
  # Skip PDF combination if only creating diagnostic
  if (create_diagnostic) {
    message("Diagnostic overlay created. Skipping PDF combination.")
    message("To see coordinate grid, check: ", files$diagnostic)
    return(TRUE)
  }
  
  # Combine PDFs using existing function
  success <- f.combine_duplicate_pdfs(
    files = files,
    pdftk_options = pdftk_options,
    gs_options = gs_options
  )
  
  # Optimize the combined PDF if requested
  if (success && optimize_pdf) {
    f.optimize_pdf(
      input_pdf = files$combined, 
      output_pdf = optimized_pdf_name,
      quality = quality,
      compatibility = compatibility,
      embed_fonts = embed_fonts,
      compress_images = compress_images
    )
    # Update the combined PDF reference to the optimized version
    files$final <- optimized_pdf_name
  } else {
    files$final <- files$combined
  }
  
  # Delete intermediate files if requested
  if (success && delete_intermediate) {
    file.remove(files$main)
    file.remove(files$overlay)
    if (optimize_pdf) {
      file.remove(files$combined)  # Remove the unoptimized combined file
    }
    message("Intermediate files deleted.")
  }
  
  if (success) {
    message(paste0(plot_type, " figure completed successfully! Check: ", files$final))
  } else {
    message(paste0(plot_type, " figure encountered issues."))
  }
  
  return(success)
}
